name: Gmail AI Reply Draft
description: Assess incoming Gmail messages, generate replies only when needed and save them as drafts in the original conversations.
requirements: One Gmail mailbox with message-read and draft-compose permission, selected on the poll, body read and draft write
Available assessment and reply models configured on the two AI Agent nodes
n8n assessment model must support temperature 0 and JSON object mode; configure both OpenAI model nodes
Enable the one-minute poll and review generated drafts manually before sending
